title: Hinomori Shiho — Lunchtime Chat〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Okay, tuning sounds goods...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I think I'll try that phrase Saki came up with.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (It really is nice.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I guess it should be considering how determined she was to actually go through and write it.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You find the things that you want to do and make sure you'll actually be able to do them, right? You've helped us so much already by doing just that.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: That's why I believe you'll be the first one to figure out what kind of feelings we want to convey as a band.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I... I got it...!!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Thank you so much, Shiho! Thank you! Thank you! I know what I want to convey with my song now!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I'm glad we got to talk that time too.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh, arranging it this way might be another option. I should write that down...
Shih really likes what Sakki came up with, huh♪
Hehe. It certainly seems that way.
It looks like she's having fun too.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Wait, Rin...?
Honami and Ichika too? What are you doing there?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Haha. Busted.
Heya, Shih☆

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: You came early today.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, but...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Would you mind telling me why you were eavesdropping?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Sorry, it looked like you were enjoying yourself and didn't want to disturb you.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Yeah, that♪
You were really on a roll there☆

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You don't feel bad about doing that, do you...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. Well, to put it another way...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We're happy about how you seem to be genuinely enjoying yourself and how the rest of us feel the same way.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: We do?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I was talking to Honami just before we both got here...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: And I mentioned how I also found myself playing the music Saki wrote for us last night.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. I felt the same way and tried imagining how I'd actually play her song.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: And when we saw you doing the same thing just now, it just felt like we've all really come together.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Okay, so that's what you meant.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: You girls are like the definition of BFFs☆

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: That aside, this music has this effect of making me want to play it over and over again.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: It really does.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: The first time I heard it, my jaw dropped as a I stood there in awe...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Like a classic that never gets old.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Heh heh heh. That has to be because she put just that much thought into it♪

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Her thoughts...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: She was probably able to write this because she is who she is.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Us knowing that may also be why this music resonates with us so much.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: You might be right.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But this is just our first step. We still have a lot of work to do until this becomes a complete song.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Right!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
That's great☆
I can't wait to hear it♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Huh? You're already here?!
But it's still early!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Were you all just talking about something just now...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. Just chatting.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hey, that's not fair.
Tell me about what, please?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Well...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: It's a secret...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Nooo!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But since you're finally here, Saki, we can get started with practice.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: No! Shiho, wait!

rows.Speaker: Saki's Voice
rows.Line: There's no way I'll be able to focus during practice if you just leave me hanging like that!

rows.Speaker: Ichika, Honami, & Rin
rows.Line:
Hehe.
Hahaha!
